components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action. Ink background, surface text. Terracotta on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1a1a18; color: #faf7f4; padding: 10px 24px; font-family: Poppins, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b84a30; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b84a30; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent, muted text, thin border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #6b6560; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Poppins, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid #ddd5cc; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #1a1a18; border-color: #4f4f49; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b84a30; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Role Badge

narrative.overview:
ALT-DECK's visual language is that of a space designed for work, not presentation. Bare walls. A music stand. No decoration that doesn't serve the session. The interface is spare, utilitarian, and confident — a professional working surface that treats its users as capable adults operating under deliberate pressure.

Color is structural, not decorative. The warm ground and off-white surface don't carry warmth as a style choice — they are the neutral room. The terracotta accent functions like a highlighter pen on a score: it marks what matters. The four nature colors are functional category signals, not visual embellishment.

Type is the primary design material. Card titles render in monospace at large weights; labels run in tight tracked uppercase. The Poppins + Lora pairing separates two registers: the systematic and the human.
keyCharacteristics: Zero-radius everywhere. The interface has edges.
Uppercase tracking (0.15em–0.20em) for all labels and category signals.
Monospace for card titles — the constraint as notation.
Subtle shadow vocabulary (ambient only) — surfaces float just enough to read at distance.
Left-border on cards is functional (nature color signal), not decorative.
Color restricted to category signals and one accent. Nothing else competes.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Terracotta appears on ≤15% of any screen. Its presence marks active state, danger, or the primary accent; its scarcity is the system's authority. Do not use it for decoration.

rules.name: The Category Rule
rules.body: The four nature colors are reserved for card category signals only. Re-using them elsewhere corrupts the categorical encoding.

rules.name: The Mono Rule
rules.body: Card titles always render in monospace. The constraint is notation. Prose fonts are for descriptions and rules; the title is the code.

rules.name: The Uppercase Ceiling
rules.body: Uppercase tracking applies only to labels (12px and below) and display headings. Body copy and Lora descriptions are sentence case. All-caps body text fails at distance.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No surface adds a shadow to signal status, hierarchy, or importance. Shadows exist only where distance-readability requires it.

dos: Do use zero border-radius everywhere. The square edge is a deliberate system choice.
Do set card titles in monospace. They are notation, not prose.
Do reserve terracotta for active states, risk signals, and the primary accent mark only.
Do use the four nature colors for category signals only.
Do set all labels and nav items in uppercase with 0.15em–0.20em tracking at 0.75rem.
Do use Lora for card descriptions and constraint prose.
Do test card text at 3m distance.
Do use tonal layering (surface vs. ground) to separate surfaces.
Do include outline: 2px solid #b84a30; outline-offset: 2px on all interactive focus states.
donts: Don't use a SaaS / Notion-style aesthetic.
Don't use music streaming UI patterns.
Don't apply border-radius above 2px to any component.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left or border-right > 1px) for decoration.
Don't soften copy. The interface is declarative.
